items.text: DTI IT will never ask you for your password
Turn on multi-factor authentication for your DTI account
Never share your DTI login, not even with a classmate
Nobody from DTI will ever ask for your Mobile Money PIN
A scholarship or job that asks for a fee is a scam
Suspicious email? Use Report in Outlook, then delete it
Lock your screen when you step away ” Windows key + L
October is Breast Cancer Awareness Month
